# My365Expert

> My365Expert provides practical Microsoft 365, Azure, SharePoint, Microsoft Purview, Intune, Defender and AI/Copilot security consulting for businesses in New Zealand and Australia.

My365Expert helps organisations improve Microsoft cloud security, identity and access, data protection, endpoint security and secure AI adoption. The site publishes practical guidance for business leaders and Microsoft 365/Azure environments.

## Services

- [Microsoft 365 & Azure Security Uplift](https://www.my365expert.co/services): Assess and improve Microsoft 365 and Azure security, identity, Conditional Access, Defender, Secure Score and security baselines.
- [SharePoint Security & Optimisation](https://www.my365expert.co/services): Review SharePoint permissions, external sharing, information architecture, search and Copilot readiness.
- [Microsoft Purview & Information Protection](https://www.my365expert.co/services): Improve data protection, DLP, sensitivity labels, auditing and governance.
- [Endpoint & Intune Security](https://www.my365expert.co/services): Secure and manage devices with Intune, compliance policies, Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security baselines.
- [Microsoft AI & Copilot Security](https://www.my365expert.co/services): Prepare for Microsoft Copilot, AI agents and AI applications with secure data access and AI governance.

## Audience

My365Expert focuses on practical security and Microsoft cloud guidance for business leaders and organisations in New Zealand and Australia, particularly small and mid-sized businesses that need clear recommendations without unnecessary complexity.
